provenance.operation: Reoptimize 24 intervals at half the source planning timestep, retaining duration, objective normalization, material/contact properties, fixed initial state and reference-relative bounds. Initial guess is the previously failed linear subdivision; no prescribed contact sequence.
provenance.limitations: Finite startup horizon. Planning feasibility, geometry, detailed runtime, interpolation consistency and sustained command-responsive motion require separate checks; no physical speed maximum.
provenance.refinement: Tighten actuator-envelope tolerance and residual scale from 0.01 to 0.001 Nm after two 100-iteration solves remain infeasible. No weakening of acceptance, physical model, speed target or gait timing prescription; all other weights/grid/bounds unchanged.
provenance.derivative_refinement: After damping-limit termination, reduce normalized finite-difference probe from 1e-6 to 1e-7. Same tightened torque tolerance, all objective/physics/bounds and fixed initial state. Tests numerical derivative accuracy in stiff smooth contact, not a gait parameter sweep.
